text:
samira: Pushed a compact-toolbar mock for the Playground. Key areas: streaming display, stop/regenerate affordances, token badge behavior. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/ijkl/playground-toolbar-v3 — please skim.
chen: Looks good. Primary concern: live token updates causing layout shift on < 480px. we need a non-janky approach.
omar: Proposal: reserve the toolbar height and absolutely position the token badge. that prevents reflow. On narrow widths hide the badge behind an expand chevron.
lina: Agree with absolute badge. Accessibility: token badge must have an accessible name and an `aria-live` status for start/completion. also prefer text labels for small screens (icon + text) for clarity.
samira: For streaming text, should we show character-by-character or chunked updates? chunked seems less noisy.
chen: Chunked updates with a 200ms throttle works well. also only update token count every 300ms. reduces CPU on low-end devices.
mike: Copy suggestion: change tooltip "Stop" -> "Stop generation (keeps partial output)" and "Regenerate" -> "Regenerate response (same context)". more explicit.
omar: Keyboard flows: propose Ctrl+. to stop, Ctrl+Shift+R to regenerate, Ctrl+K to open prompt library. document conflicts and allow remapping.
lina: For screen readers, add a visually-hidden region that announces "Generation started" and then "Generation finished, X tokens." use role=status and aria-atomic=true.
qa-bot: Test plan note: add e2e scenarios: start generation, verify aria announcements, stop with keyboard, regenerate, verify token badge shows estimated (~N) then final. add waitForStableText guard to reduce flakiness.
samira: Mobile behavior: drawer should slide up from bottom. toolbar expand tap reveals token badge and regenerate button. add small animation for affordance discoverability.
chen: Color contrast: stop button red at small size fails 4.5:1. need alternate high-contrast variant in figma styles.
omar: Telemetry: events: playground.generation_started, playground.generation_stopped, playground.regenerated, playground.token_badge_shown. include properties: {ui_variant, device_width, estimated:true|false}.
lina: Small a11y nit: ensure focus order keeps the stop button reachable via keyboard when drawer opens. and use focus trapping only for modal drawers.
mike: I'll mock a tiny demo branch with the absolute badge and throttled updates for review.
samira: Thanks — next steps: Mike demo branch; Chen to add keyboard mapping doc; Lina to draft a11y checklist; QA to add tests; I'll schedule a quick 20-min usability sync next Tue. Drop any micro-nits as figma comments. :thumbsup:
